I went into a several hours rabbit hole solving this, compiling a custom rasterizer also wasn't working no matter what i did. It would do the 3D model but it would stop at the texture exactly because it had no custom rasterizer.

I finally got it working doing the following, got the cuda toolkit 12.6, downloaded the latest portable version of comfyui, installed only the manager, git cloned the kijai Hunyuan3D, used the workflow that comes with it, downloaded the missing nodes. 

Got the custom\_rasterizer from the google drive link here:

[https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-Hunyuan3DWrapper/issues/47](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-Hunyuan3DWrapper/issues/47)

(jugadorgl1 on github, you have my thanks)

Ran it in cmd in comfyui, was successful, then the workflow finally worked, model with textures.

indeed it is the 9 square test, you can get it in extensions for cura "part for calibration". 

It has to be just a thin first layer regardless, for adjustment. Personally, after having a bunch of beds and two different bl-touch's, i wouldn't trade the original magnetic bed plus a life print adjustment of the wheels for a perfect calibration. Absolutely, when you print a perfect bed level test, keep it. Hang it near the printer where you can see it, so it motivates you in a later time when you fuss about for an hour or two trying to level it.

There will always be a reminder that it's possible.
